text: # Incident Report: SIM Provisioning Delay Post-System Upgrade **Document ID:** INC_C05_INC_2026_0171 **Category:** C05 — SIM Card Services **Department:** Customer Care **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-07-31 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Summary A provisioning-system upgrade introduced a queueing bug that delayed new SIM activations by up to 6 hours. ## Detection Method Detected automatically via NOC monitoring alarms, which triggered an on-call page within the standard 5-minute alerting SLA. ## Timeline Issue identified via spike in activation-status complaint tickets; rollback of the upgrade completed within 3 hours; backlog cleared within 8 hours. | Time | Event | Observation | Action | |---|---|---|---| | T+0 | Fault detected | Alarm/ticket volume triggers investigation | On-call engineer paged | | T+10m | Initial triage | Affected scope estimated | Field/remote team engaged as needed | | T+Xh | Interim mitigation | Partial service restored where possible | Status page updated | | T+Yh | Full restoration | Service confirmed normal | Incident closed, RCA initiated if required | ## Customer Impact Estimated customers affected and service categories impacted are recorded in the internal incident-management system (ref: INC-2026-0171).
